description: Track a DPX settlement via SWIFT gpi-compatible status. Given a UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference), returns gpi-format payment status including a pacs.002 payload that a SWIFT member bank can submit to the gpi Tracker. DPX is not a SWIFT member — the SWIFT member bank submits the returned pacs.002 to the gpi Tracker via their own gpi API access.

uetr.description: RFC 4122 UUID UETR assigned at payment initiation, e.g. "97ed4827-7b6f-4491-a06f-b548d5a7512d".

name: swift.gpi_track
